components.name: Contact Button
components.description: Primary luminous pill for direct contact.
components.css: .ds-contact { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:9999px; color:#fff; padding:12px 32px; font:500 14px Kanit,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; background:linear-gradient(123deg,#18011F 7%,#B600A8 37%,#7621B0 72%,#BE4C00 100%); box-shadow:0 4px 4px rgba(181,1,167,.25),4px 4px 12px #7721B1 inset; outline:2px solid #fff; outline-offset:-3px; }

components.name: Outline Project Action

narrative.overview: A quirky, cinematic, futuristic scientific observatory where biological intelligence, computational machinery, and verifiable engineering work feel alive. Layered atmosphere creates depth while scale, overlap, contrast, and selective elevation direct attention through the portfolio.
keyCharacteristics: Sparse bioelectric cyan and neural violet signals
Technical mono readouts grounded in evidence

rules.name: The Signal, Not Wallpaper Rule
rules.body: Cyan and violet identify energy, state, and connection; broad neutral fields preserve their meaning.

rules.name: The Monument and Readout Rule
rules.body: Kanit creates the monument; JetBrains Mono supplies literal technical readouts.

rules.name: The Eye-Path Rule
rules.body: Elevation identifies the current focal point or next action and is removed when it no longer clarifies hierarchy.

dos: Preserve the contrast between cinematic spectacle and inspectable evidence.
Use scale, overlap, tonal chapters, and selective elevation to create a clear eye path.
Keep cyan and violet attached to signals, biological energy, and computational connection.
Use fluid type and responsive spacing so monumental hierarchy survives small screens.
donts: Do not flatten the interface into a generic grid of same-sized cards.
Do not distribute glow, shadow, blur, or 3D effects evenly.
Do not introduce unrelated hues without deliberately redefining the system.
Do not fabricate scientific imagery, metrics, endorsements, or claims.
